build_wav2vec2_model: build a Wav2Vec2Model from a Wav2Vec2Config to pre-train on raw audio waveforms
extract_features_wav2vec2: extract contextual features from audio waveforms using the Wav2Vec2Model extract_features method
quantize_wav2vec2: quantize audio features using the GumbelVectorQuantizer in Wav2Vec2Model to get discrete codes
remove_pretraining_modules: remove pre-training modules like quantizer and final_proj from Wav2Vec2Model for fine-tuning
configure_wav2vec2: configure a Wav2Vec2Config dataclass to set encoder layers, dropout, masking, and quantization parameters
